newsitem.title: UK: Brockbank group underwriter at Lloyd's resigns.
newsitem.headline: Brockbank group underwriter at Lloyd's resigns.

text.p: The Brockbank insurance group said on Wednesday that Simon Spinney is to resign as active underwriter of Lloyd's of London syndicate 588.
Spinney plans to join rival Lloyd's managing agency, Duncanson & Holt Syndicate Management Limited, along with his deputy underwriter.
In a statement the board of Brockbank said Spinney would have to abide by the conditions of his contract and be available to manage the syndicate's business until November 1997.
"The agency is now seeking a replacement of suitable calibre to replace Mr Spinney," the statement said
Mr. Spinney joined Brockbank as Deputy Underwriter in 1990, and in 1991 took over from Mark Brockbank as active underwriter of Syndicate 588.
